topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 21 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 6 common project-authored base contract(s) (gravitabase, basemath, addresses). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
